Two first-time listings broaden reimbursement access; the release gives no sales impact or prior-period comparison.
The effective date sets when the new reimbursement access begins; uptake and revenue impact are not quantified.

This is a commercial-access update for Zai Lab's China medicines, adding first-time listings while maintaining coverage for three others. Evidence of uptake and any resulting sales impact after the list takes effect on Jan. 1, 2027, would make it a larger catalyst.
